atoms.text: Penny says: “I live in a city and I love it. The main reason why I like being a city girl is that I am more independent here than I would be in the countryside. When I want to meet my friends, I can go on my own. I don't need my parents to drive me everywhere. I'm 13, so I don't want to turn up with my parents anymore. I usually go everywhere by public transport. If it isn't too far away, I also walk or go by bike.”

atoms.text: Kaito says: “I am a fan of cities and there are many reasons why. One of them is that there is so much to do in a city. The leisure opportunities seem to be endless in the city. I can go to the opera, theatre or concerts. My friends and I often go to the cinema together. If we are hungry, we can also choose between lots of different cafés and restaurants. For instance, we can eat Chinese, Indian, Turkish or English food. There are so many vegan options too, even at the ice cream shops.”

atoms.text: Kayley says: “Do I love cities? Of course, I do. What I like the most about cities is the diversity of the people. I have a neighbour who comes from South Korea and speaks Italian. My best friend is Indian and a Buddhist and I am an Irish Muslim. In a city, it is a lot easier to get to know people with different nationalities, languages and religions. It is so much fun to learn something new about various cultures. I wouldn't want to miss it.”
